name: Doppler
description:
About This Game

MASTER THE SPEED

Die fast. Restart faster. Scream a little.

Meet Doppler, a little blue ball of nerves with a red bandana blowing in the wind. Welcome to a brutal, lightning-fast platformer built around speed, precision, and rapid-fire retries. Every jump matters, and every movement can save you precious seconds.

Short, intense levels, precise controls, and instant respawns. No time to waste: miss a jump, restart, and get right back into the action.

You will fail. A lot. But with every attempt, you'll go further and get faster.

And one day, everything clicks: the perfect jump, the perfect timing, the perfect line.

The perfect run.

BEAT YOUR BEST RUN

Your best time is automatically saved and becomes your Ghost.

On every new attempt, your Ghost replays your best performance in real time, letting you see exactly where you're gaining ground… and where you're falling behind.

YOUR STYLE

Unlock different skins, each with its own color and unique trail.

Pick your favorite and leave your mark across the levels. Whether you stick with the classic Doppler look or switch things up, it's up to you to choose how you race through the world.

RESTART. AGAIN. AND AGAIN.

Doppler rewards mastery, persistence, and that irresistible urge to try just one more time.

Then one more.

And one more after that.

Until your time is perfect.

No excuses.
No mercy.

Just you, Doppler… and the perfect run.
short_desc: Die fast. Restart even faster. Scream a little. Meet Doppler, a small blue bundle of rage with a red bandana in the wind.
